reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Adding CRD to MRD conversion to packages that have the SafeStart capability by @n3wscott in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6639", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Packages that have the SafeStart capability will now have their CRDs converted to MRDs; the release notes state no failure, only this new conversion behavior.
consequence.remediation: No action is stated; verify that CRD to MRD conversion is expected for any packages using the SafeStart capability.

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 adds CRD to MRD conversion to packages that have the SafeStart capability.
